destination.title: Scalar potentials, physical trajectories and cosmic evolution
destination.question: How do scalar and axionic potentials, kinetic geometry and energy transfer determine field excursions, vacuum structure and cosmological evolution, and what is needed for effective-theory control?
destination.summary: A shared direction connects geometric range questions, dynamical trajectories, Higgs vacuum selection and distinct cosmological applications. Their premises and mechanisms remain separate.

systems: Single and multiple axions with companion fields
targets: Periods, geometric ranges and proper trajectories
Inflation, energy transfer and early or late cosmic evolution
Potential generation, backreaction and effective-theory control
regimes: Zero-temperature and separately specified thermal potentials
assumptions: A specified geometric path need not be dynamically realized
Moduli decoupling may be assumed rather than constructed
Scanning, potential regularity and vacuum-survival conditions are source-specific
Quantum-gravity criteria remain conditional where invoked
conventions: Geometry, potential traversability and cosmological viability are separate targets
Non-monodromic compact ranges and monodromic excursions are distinct
Vacuum stability and scale selection are not interchangeable
includes: Conditional negative results and missing dynamical completion
Applications to screening and relic production through explicit links
excludes: An inferred inflationary solution from a metric alone
A common selection mechanism or complete cosmological history

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: How does axionic motion change the proper excursion associated with a fixed radial approach to infinite distance?

sources.title: Gauge hierarchy and metastability from Higgs-driven crunching

evidence.text: Can Higgs-driven cosmological crunching dynamically select a hierarchically small Higgs mass and a metastable electroweak vacuum, and what new physics would make the selected scale phenomenologically relevant?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Which supersymmetry-breaking contributions can cancel a small negative vacuum energy without overwhelming the non-perturbatively generated gravitino scale? The source explores existing uplift proposals and their compatibility with flux-stabilized sectors.

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: How can a supergravity model with broken local supersymmetry avoid a vacuum energy density of order m_{3/2}²M_Pl² and account for a much smaller positive cosmological energy density?

sources.title: Dark Energy density in Split SUSY models inspired by degenerate vacua

evidence.text: Can a physical SUSY-breaking vacuum, assumed degenerate with a second initially supersymmetric vacuum, inherit a small positive dark-energy density generated by strong dynamics in that second phase, and what Split SUSY scales would reproduce the paper's observational target?

sources.title: Non-gaussianity in axion N-flation models: detailed predictions and mass spectra

evidence.text: What probability distributions and correlations of the scalar tilt, tensor ratio, bispectrum and trispectrum arise in axion N-flation, and how tightly must unequal masses be packed to satisfy the observational constraints used in the paper?

sources.title: Higgs mass and vacuum stability in the Standard Model at NNLO

evidence.text: What Higgs mass ensures absolute Standard Model vacuum stability up to the Planck scale after NNLO matching and running, and what do the resulting near-critical couplings imply for proposed Planck-scale boundary conditions and Higgs inflation?

sources.title: A review of Axion Inflation in the era of Planck

evidence.text: How can axion shift symmetry protect inflation from ultraviolet corrections, which constructions realize sufficient inflation, and what signatures and constraints follow in the Planck-2013 observational setting?

sources.title: Dark energy from approximate U(1)$_{de}$ symmetry

evidence.text: Can an extremely small dark-energy potential arise from electroweak and GUT mass scales through a quintessential pseudo-Goldstone boson whose approximate symmetry descends from ultraviolet-safe discrete symmetries?

sources.title: The inflaton as an MSSM Higgs and open string modulus monodromy inflation

evidence.text: Can the heavy MSSM Higgs provide an approximately quadratic inflaton potential at a SUSY-breaking scale near 10^13 GeV, with trans-Planckian excursions realized through Wilson-line or D-brane-position monodromy?

sources.title: Natural and Multi-Natural Inflation in Axion Landscape

evidence.text: Can accidental alignment among many axions with sub-Planckian decay constants produce a sufficiently flat, super-Planckian inflationary direction, and connect slow-roll inflation after tunneling to the numbers of axions and symmetry-breaking sources?

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation: Monodromies of two Axions

evidence.text: Can alignment of two axions provide the large effective displacement needed for natural inflation while keeping individual decay constants below the Planck scale, and how does the misalignment parameter determine the predicted scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Evidence of the Big Fix

evidence.text: Does the proposed Big Fix maximum-entropy principle receive model evidence from late-universe radiation being maximized near the observed Higgs expectation value, when current quark masses, gauge couplings and the Higgs self-coupling are held fixed?

sources.title: Combining Universal and Odd RR Axions for Aligned Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can KNP alignment of the universal RR axion C0 and one orientifold-odd C2 axion produce a trans-Planckian effective decay constant in weakly coupled type IIB large-volume compactifications while retaining moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Weak Scale From the Maximum Entropy Principle

evidence.text: Can maximizing the final radiation of a postulated closed universe select a weak scale near the observed scale when the Higgs expectation value varies while dimensionless Standard Model couplings remain fixed?

sources.title: Trajectories with suppressed tensor-to-scalar ratio in Aligned Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Which inflationary trajectories occur in the general two-axion aligned potential, and can their scalar tilt, tensor amplitude or gauge-field couplings distinguish Aligned Natural Inflation from single-field Natural Inflation?

sources.title: Cosmological Relaxation of the Electroweak Scale

evidence.text: Can early-universe dynamics select an electroweak scale parametrically below the Higgs-sector cutoff, using technically natural small parameters without requiring new particles to cancel Higgs loops at the weak scale or an anthropic selection argument?

sources.title: On Natural Inflation and Moduli Stabilisation in String Theory

evidence.text: Can flux-induced axion alignment produce a controlled super-Planckian effective decay constant once the same fluxes' effects on moduli and instanton amplitudes are included?

sources.title: Standard model cross-over on the lattice

evidence.text: What are the pseudocritical temperature, thermodynamic response and screening properties of the Standard Model electroweak cross-over at the physical Higgs mass, after including hypercharge and extrapolating lattice measurements to the continuum?

sources.title: Axion decay constants away from the lamppost

evidence.text: How large can axion periods become in controlled string compactifications, including small-radius regions, and which geometric or duality effects limit their growth? The paper seeks quantitative examples rather than a general quantum-gravity bound.

sources.title: Subleading Effects and the Field Range in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Can significant but subleading nonperturbative axion corrections enhance inflationary e-folds, reduce the required field range and decay constant, and produce distinctive observables instead of trapping the inflaton or merely perturbing smooth slow roll?

sources.title: Backreacted Axion Field Ranges in String Theory

evidence.text: Can closed-string axions acquire parametrically super-Planckian proper excursions through flux-induced monodromy or alignment once the same fluxes and axion energy backreact on their field-space metric?

sources.title: Phenomenological aspects from vacuum stability and metastability in models with soft breaking of a \texorpdfstring{$U\left( 1\right)$}{lg} global symmetry

evidence.text: How do competing neutral electroweak minima constrain a softly broken U(1) two-Higgs-doublet model, its one-loop running, alignment benchmarks and scalar masses compatible with diphoton and electroweak precision fits?

sources.title: Backreaction Issues in Axion Monodromy and Minkowski 4-forms

evidence.text: Why does a Kaloper–Sorbo coupling fail to guarantee a transplanckian axion range in string compactifications, and is the onset of saxion backreaction necessarily tied to the Planck scale?

sources.title: Multiple-axion framework

evidence.text: Can a systematic treatment of many-axion potentials identify their vacuum structure and support metastability, inflation, a small cosmological constant, and ultralight axion dark matter within one effective framework?

sources.title: Backreaction in Axion Monodromy, 4-forms and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an axion wind over a transplanckian proper distance while other compactification fields remain stabilized and below the effective-theory cutoff? The relevant range is determined by the backreacted metric, rather than coordinate displacement alone.

sources.title: Systematics of Aligned Axions

evidence.text: How can exact and approximate shift symmetries make multi-axion potentials tractable, allowing systematic characterization of critical points, vacuum energies and smooth field-space regions relevant to inflation?

sources.title: Large Field Inflation/Quintessence and the Refined Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an axion traverse a large canonical distance in a string-derived cosmological effective theory while heavy fields remain stabilized and all retained masses remain below the ultraviolet cutoff?

sources.title: Mass Hierarchies and Dynamical Field Range

evidence.text: The closed-string example asks whether a previously reported flux-independent critical axion range survives the kinetic self-consistency test when the axion cannot be parametrically separated from the other moduli.

sources.title: Mass Hierarchies and Dynamical Field Range

evidence.text: The model tests whether a light open-string axion can move while stabilized closed-string moduli contribute negligibly to the field-space length. Its independent superpotential coefficient mu permits a formal heavy-to-light hierarchy.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Combine a world-volume-flux D-term with non-perturbative stabilization, then minimize over charged open fields. A viable uplift requires a surviving positive contribution at the small vacuum-energy scale rather than automatic D-flatness or a Planck-scale energy.

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: Run the physical coupling from M_Z to M_S, match the two phase couplings, and evolve the second phase to the formal zero of its inverse coupling. Change the beta coefficient whenever the light matter spectrum changes.

sources.title: Dark Energy density in Split SUSY models inspired by degenerate vacua

evidence.text: The reviewed hidden-sector construction uses a positive-semidefinite scalar potential proportional to |∂zŴ|². Its minima illustrate degenerate zero-energy phases with different SUSY properties, rather than deriving degeneracy for an arbitrary phenomenological supergravity model.

sources.title: Non-gaussianity in axion N-flation models: detailed predictions and mass spectra

evidence.text: Numerical field evolution is repeated over random initial angles to estimate observable distributions and correlations. The detailed equal-mass distribution uses 100 realizations at f=MP, N*=50, Nf=2150; unequal-mass parameter maps generally average ten realizations per sampled point.

sources.title: Higgs mass and vacuum stability in the Standard Model at NNLO

evidence.text: Two-loop QCD thresholds use a Taylor expansion in xht=Mh²/Mt² through xht⁴. In the Yukawa result, Nc² and Nc⁰ pieces are exact, while the Nc piece uses a large-top-mass asymptotic expansion through xht³.

sources.title: A review of Axion Inflation in the era of Planck

evidence.text: For Abelian production, the review presents helicity mode equations, constant-ξ Coulomb-function solutions and an adiabatic-vacuum approximation. Backreaction is described through a mean-field inflaton equation and an approximate sourced perturbation equation.

sources.title: Relic Abundance of Dark Photon Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can energy initially stored in a misaligned axion produce the observed abundance of very light massive-vector dark matter through tachyonic amplification, including masses far below those efficiently populated by inflationary fluctuations?

sources.title: On the Possibility of Large Axion Moduli Spaces

evidence.text: Can multiple axions yield a parametrically large inflationary field range without monodromy in a controlled string compactification, particularly through diagonal motion or kinetic alignment?

destination.question: Which mechanisms generate particle masses and spectra, control physical CP phases or protect selected particles and operators, and which symmetry, ultraviolet and scale assumptions do they require?
destination.summary: Connects weak-scale mechanisms, neutrino masses, strong CP, particle stability and consistency methods without identifying their protecting symmetries or explanatory targets.

systems: Higgs, neutrino, flavour and supersymmetric extensions
QCD axions and alternative strong-CP mechanisms
Hidden charged particles and other protected sectors
targets: Physical CP phases and strong-CP protection
regimes: Seesaw, radiative, symmetry-breaking and mediation mechanisms
Continuous gauge, discrete gauge and global symmetries as distinct cases
assumptions: Dirac neutrino character is a model choice
Charge protection requires the specified spectrum and charge ordering

conventions: Decay protection does not eliminate annihilation or collective depletion

sources.title: Theory and phenomenology of Dirac neutrinos

evidence.text: How can symmetry-protected seesaw and radiative mechanisms explain small Dirac neutrino masses while connecting neutrino nature to dark matter stability, flavour predictions and observable charged lepton flavour violation?

sources.title: A Novel string derived Z-prime with stable proton, light-neutrinos and R-parity violation

evidence.text: Can a low-energy Abelian gauge symmetry protect the proton without obstructing fermion masses or a neutrino seesaw? The proposed symmetry must also be family universal and anomaly free.

sources.title: A Novel string derived Z-prime with stable proton, light-neutrinos and R-parity violation

evidence.text: Can the extra proton-protecting U(1) coexist with light active neutrinos? The neutral singlets and heavy-singlet Higgs VEV provide operators that preserve the residual gauge symmetry while generating a seesaw mass matrix.

sources.title: The Lee-Wick standard model

evidence.text: The proposed extension seeks Higgs-mass stabilization by adding higher derivative kinetic operators throughout the Standard Model. Each operator introduces a massive resonance rather than a new stable asymptotic particle, with its mass initially independent of the masses in other representations.

sources.title: The Lee-Wick standard model

evidence.text: The hierarchy problem asks why the Higgs mass remains small compared with a very high ultraviolet scale. This paper investigates whether higher derivative kinetic operators and their massive Lee-Wick resonances can remove quadratic radiative sensitivity while retaining a usable perturbative theory.

sources.title: SUSY without the Little Hierarchy

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric pseudo-Goldstone Higgs receive a sufficiently large quartic interaction without a corresponding large quadratic term, reducing the little-hierarchy tuning while allowing light stops and satisfying the paper's precision and perturbativity requirements?

sources.title: Mixed Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking with Anomalous U(1) Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: How do the characteristics and stabilization of anomalous-U(1) D-flat directions determine the relative contributions of modulus, gauge, anomaly and D-term mediation in vacua with nearly vanishing cosmological constant?

sources.title: Constraints on LVS Compactifications of IIB String Theory

evidence.text: Which versions of type IIB LVS remain phenomenologically viable after imposing effective-supergravity validity, flavor constraints, nonperturbative matter couplings and cosmology? The author argues that a sequestered scenario with Weyl-anomaly and RG-generated soft terms is favored.

sources.title: Axion-Higgs Unification

evidence.text: Can scalar-free strong dynamics unify the Higgs and QCD axion as composite pseudo-Nambu–Goldstone bosons at Λ ∼ 10^11 GeV, while accommodating fermion masses, a small high-scale Higgs quartic and potentially gauge-coupling unification?

sources.title: Effects of Planck Scale Physics on Neutrino Mixing Parameters in Left-Right Symmetric Models

evidence.text: Can explicitly D-parity-breaking, Planck-suppressed operators significantly alter tree-level neutrino masses and mixing in left-right symmetric models, particularly when an additional scalar singlet permits dimension-five operators?

sources.title: Challenges for the Nelson-Barr Mechanism

evidence.text: Under what ultraviolet, symmetry and supersymmetry-breaking conditions can spontaneous CP violation implement Nelson–Barr strong-CP protection naturally, while retaining a large CKM phase and suppressing higher-dimension and radiative corrections?

sources.title: Strong CP and SUZ$_{2}$

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry stabilize the symmetry-breaking scales introduced by Z2 solutions to strong CP while preserving their protection of the QCD vacuum angle?

sources.title: Constraining Neutrino Masses, the Cosmological Constant and BSM Physics from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Which proposed neutral fermions could populate the neutrino-scale spectrum, and which existing bounds depend on their thermal history or supersymmetry-breaking realization?

sources.title: Protecting the Axion with Local Baryon Number

evidence.text: Can gauged baryon number protect an accidental PQ symmetry from dangerous Planck-suppressed operators while its anomaly-canceling exotic fermions implement the KSVZ hidden-axion mechanism?

sources.title: Simplest little Higgs model revisited: Hidden mass relation, unitarity, and naturalness

evidence.text: Which quantitative electroweak symmetry breaking predictions and fine-tuning constraints survive in the Simplest Little Higgs model when its scalar potential is renormalized as a continuum EFT, without assuming vanishing UV contributions?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Does a gravitationally generated axion harmonic preserve the QCD axion's cancellation of strong CP? The reviewed model compares a QCD cosine minimized at zero with a second cosine of the same period and a generic relative phase.

sources.title: Higgs scalar potential in asymptotically safe quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can gravitational fluctuations near an asymptotically safe UV fixed point make the Higgs quartic coupling and mass term irrelevant, thereby predicting Higgs properties or explaining the electroweak–Planck hierarchy?

sources.title: Dark matter stability and Dirac neutrinos using only Standard Model symmetries

evidence.text: Can the SM's existing B−L symmetry, with suitable new fields and spontaneous breaking, simultaneously protect Dirac neutrinos, forbid tree-level neutrino masses, and stabilize particles that generate neutrino masses radiatively?

sources.title: Axion RG flows and the holographic dynamics of instanton densities

evidence.text: Can the axion endpoint prescription be derived beyond specific string constructions, and does it survive explicit nonperturbative shift breaking? Can running theta be constrained in QCD-like theories or supply useful vacuum branches in self-tuning models?

sources.title: Gauge and gravitational instantons: From 3-forms and fermions to Weak Gravity and flat axion potentials

evidence.text: When can fundamental Dirac matter be omitted from an instanton EFT below the Higgs scale v? Heavy fermions decouple with corrections in v/m; light fermions alter both instanton running and the effective interactions that must remain in the theory.

sources.title: Gravity, Superselection Rules and Axions

evidence.text: Can coupling to quantum gravity turn a superselection parameter into a local field's vacuum expectation value? The proposed example is the QCD θ parameter and its promotion to an axion.

sources.title: A Holographic Perspective on the Axion Quality Problem

evidence.text: Can a holographic composite axion retain its QCD coupling while sufficiently suppressing gravitational PQ violation through separation between an IR-localized axion and UV sources of explicit breaking?

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: What QCD vacuum structure is calculable with light composite fields? Leading-order chiral dynamics describes N light flavors while masses and θ vary, subject to confinement and the stated spontaneous chiral-symmetry-breaking pattern.

sources.title: New Approaches to the Hierarchy Problem and their Signatures from Microscopic to Cosmic Scales

evidence.text: How can microscopic physics generate an electroweak scale v with v/Λ ≪ 1? The dissertation explores neutral naturalness through cosmology and collider signatures, and noncommutative UV/IR mixing as an exploratory alternative.

sources.title: On the F-term problem and quintessence supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry breaking from rolling quintessence, mediated through kinetic couplings, generate substantial scalar and Majorana gaugino masses without spoiling slow roll or introducing pathological kinetic terms?

sources.title: Peccei-Quinn symmetry with residual symmetries

evidence.text: Can a PQ symmetry with residual discrete subgroups produce an invisible axion from low, potentially TeV-scale scalar VEVs, suppressing its fermion couplings while avoiding the Higgs-portal tuning associated with a very high symmetry-breaking scale?

sources.title: Theory Closing Talk

evidence.text: What explains the electroweak scale after the LHC's then-null direct searches, and which assumptions underlying Higgs naturalness could be relaxed to motivate alternatives to symmetry-based explanations?

sources.title: The dark dimension and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the proposed sterile tower generate active masses without producing excluded oscillations or excessive early-universe radiation?

sources.title: The dark dimension and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can inferred high-scale gauge unification and proton stability coexist with a substantially lower higher-dimensional Planck scale?

sources.title: Neutrino Masses from Generalized Symmetry Breaking

evidence.text: Can non-invertible chiral symmetries protect vanishing neutrino masses while motivating UV gauge effects that generate exponentially small Majorana or Dirac masses from charged-lepton Yukawas?

sources.title: A Novel string derived Z-prime with stable proton, light-neutrinos and R-parity violation

evidence.text: Replace specified parent-operator fields by their VEVs, preserve all cutoff powers, and impose the quoted coefficient limits. The output is conditional on both the integer insertion orders and the existence of the required charged fields.

sources.title: The Lee-Wick standard model

evidence.text: Choose representation-matched auxiliary fields, verify their elimination reproduces the specified operator, and shift fields to diagonalize kinetic mixing. Keep all induced interactions and distinguish physical observables from gauge-dependent off-shell quantities when comparing formulations.

sources.title: SUSY without the Little Hierarchy

evidence.text: Integrate out heavy Higgs-sector fields at tree level to derive effective D-terms. Analyze their charge dependence and supersymmetric and large-soft-mass limits to isolate an enhancement proportional only to the hypercharge D-term.

sources.title: Mixed Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking with Anomalous U(1) Gauge Symmetry

evidence.text: Model sequestered uplifting through a nonlinear Goldstino/Volkov–Akulov sector, giving V_lift=M^4 exp(2K/3) in Einstein frame. The uplift must be included explicitly when a relevant D-flat direction has mass comparable to or below m_3/2.

sources.title: Constraints on LVS Compactifications of IIB String Theory

evidence.text: The supercovariant derivative expansion counts derivatives, fermion bilinears and auxiliary F terms together. The author requires |F|/M²≪1 as well as small derivatives and fermion bilinears, with M the lowest integrated-out mass scale.

sources.title: Axion-Higgs Unification

evidence.text: Coset NGB matrices and Yukawa spurions organize gauge and four-fermion contributions to the potential. The appendix estimates leading quark-loop potentials and expands them to identify Higgs and σHuHd interactions.

sources.title: Strong-$CP$ with and without gravity

evidence.text: Does coupling QCD to gravity turn strong CP from a naturalness puzzle into a consistency condition requiring an exact axion mechanism, and can a gauge formulation protect that mechanism without a global Peccei–Quinn symmetry?

sources.title: Hidden Charged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exact hidden charge conservation stabilize thermal dark matter while satisfying relic-abundance, small-scale structure, enhanced-annihilation and halo self-interaction constraints?
